sources.title: pixai-labs/pixai-tagger-v1.0 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Tagger v1.0 reaches 0.6660 micro F1, a 2.25 percentage-point lead over the next model, and 0.3807 mAP on 8,407 shared General tags. These results describe the evaluated models and dataset, rather than every available tagger.

sources.title: GitHub - async0x42/pixaitaggeronnxgui: ONNX tagger GUI
sources.snippet: PixAI Tagger ONNX GUI utilizes the ONNX version of the image tagging model developed by PixAI to assign tags to local images. The original PixAI Tagger supports over 13,000 rich tags, offering an advantage compared to common tagging models (e.g., wd-tagger's ~10,000 tags).
